info.description: Facilitates the process for ordering a Broker Price Opinion (BPO) or appraisal to establish the current estimated value of a property for the purpose of evaluating a loan for Mortgage Insurance (MI) termination, processing a Fannie Mae short sale or mortgage release, issuing bidding instructions for a mortgage loan referred for foreclosure, or requesting approval for a charge-off of a first mortgage lien. Additionally, the API provides features to manage the order request, view the associated status messages and updates, and retrieve the Property Valuation Amount via the completed valuation PDF.
